inventoryScope: 723 numbered paragraph exercises (594 main, 38 paragraph review, 91 cumulative review), 13 supplementary numbered exercises, 19 theory paragraphs, 97 theory-question entries, 18 computer-assignment blocks and 5 research-project topics. Embedded worked examples and proofs belong to the corresponding paragraph or supplement article. Supplement articles are recorded separately. Source metadata is not a completed lesson.
sourcePageMapping: PDF page = printed page + 1. Entries and their components record verified source pages, including continuations.
sourceExtractionNote: Much of the textbook body is vector outlines. Extracted text does not contain complete statements. Exercise statements must be reconstructed and visually checked before authoring. Raw scans and OCR are not included in this index.
answerNumberingNote: The answers section includes 20.92; the main exercise sequence ends at 20.91 on printed page 194. Inventory follows exercise statements, not answer labels.
